hooks.name: Auto-redeploy Docker on git commit
hooks.description: After a git commit via execute_bash, surfaces the deploy.log tail so you can see rebuild progress without leaving Kiro.

action.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fires after any execute_bash tool call.
# Reads stdin for the command that was just run; if it was a git commit,
# the git post-commit hook (scripts/git-hooks/post-commit) will have already
# triggered deploy.sh. This hook just surfaces that deploy.log tail in Kiro.

INPUT=$(cat)
CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null || true)

# Only act on git commit commands
if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^git commit'; then
  LOG="/Users/manishkumar/Desktop/alpha-forge/scripts/deploy.log"
  if [[ -f "$LOG" ]]; then
    echo "--- Deploy log (last 20 lines) ---"
    tail -20 "$LOG"
  fi
fi
